messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Information Provision" as it appears in the following examples.
['During our regularly scheduled account maintenance and verification procedures, we were unable to verify your account information.', 'Recently, our Account Review Team identified some unusual activity in your account.', 'Your account has been suspended due to incorrect validation of your Personal details.', 'ONLINE BANKING UPDATES', 'Bank of America Your Online Banking is Blocked', "We've Limited your account access.", 'Your online access has been restricted.', 'We would like to notify you that NatWest bank carries out customer data verification procedure that is compulsory for all NatWest bank customers.', 'This is your final message to inform you as of 28 - March - 2015 that you have not yet reviewed your Apple Profile information.', 'Your online access has been restricted.', 'Our system detected irregular activity on your HSBC Check Card on 16 February 2010.', 'To prevent unauthorized access to your accounts, we have suspended your use of this service.', "We've just sent an e-mail to charles_liray2006@yahoo.co.uk to let them know there's a payment waiting for them to collect.", 'I have Paid there registration fee for your Check which has been with me for a long time.', 'Unfortunately, access to your account has been limited.', 'Your Lloyds TSB Online Password and Memorable Word is revoked, due to invalid logon attempts by a suspected third-party user.', 'Due to the emergency situation with our server room, HSBC Bank is presently unable to process wire transfers.', 'We have received your payroll processing request.', 'After the last annual calculations of your fiscal activity, we have determined that you are eligible to receive a tax refund of 4500.00 GBP.', 'To help protect our customers we are implementing new security features which will change how you currently log into online banking.', 'Our system has detected unusual charges to a credit card linked to your PayPal account.', 'we were unable to verify your account details.', 'We just want to confirm the payment made to your NatWest Credit Card account.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

content: {"summary": "We provide account, payment, and security updates, request verification of customer information, and explain access restrictions, unusual activity, and service changes."}
